in_marathi.name: Mitul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mitul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From Sanskrit 'Mitra' meaning friend. This name signifies a bond of friendship, love and companionship. In Hindu mythology, Mitra is one of the divine twins, the Ashvins, who are the gods of friendship, healing, and fertility.
